description: Grounds a data agent on a Fabric Ontology (or GraphModel) so the LLM can answer questions by traversing governed entity/relationship types instead of guessing joins. The ontology is attached as a FabricItem datasource; then scope which entity types the agent uses with select-tables --elements.
notes: An Ontology data source exposes entity types (not tables) as its elements. Use 'fabio data-agent list-elements' to see them, then scope the agent with element-mode selection: 'fabio data-agent select-tables --datasource ClinicalSupplyChain --elements Study,Site,Inventory' (or --all-elements). --tables/--all-tables only match table-typed elements and will not match ontology entity types. Bind the ontology to its data first with 'fabio ontology bind' so its graph is queryable. Supported artifact types: Lakehouse, Warehouse, KQLDatabase, SemanticModel, Ontology, GraphModel, MirroredDatabase, SQLDatabase.
